records.description: Well documented historic cruising area in the pine woodland on the edge of Castellarnau. Gays-Cruising and Cruisingmap both refer to the same neighborhood and woodland, with Cruisingmap showing August–September 2026 dated invitations or planned visits, not eyewitness accounts of completed encounters. Independent Sabadell newspapers in 2019 and 2022 recorded neighbors' complaints and police responses, including suspected assaults, and report parking bans to deter public sex. Forest access may also be subject to 2026 African swine fever natural-area restrictions.

records.name: Bosc CanDeu
records.location: Bosc de Can Deu, Sabadell, Catalonia, forest around Masia de Can Deu and its approach paths
records.description: A large wooded natural area north of Sabadell has an archived cruising entry describing paths near the masia. Directory platform check-in aggregates may show recent interest, but independent official reporting is decisive: Sabadell's 2026 African swine fever measures still prohibit access to natural areas, explicitly including Bosc de Can Deu. The municipal council sought a review of the restrictions in October 2026; a request to reopen does not mean access is permitted. No recent witnessed cruising is verified.

records.name: Playa del Molí

records.description: Naturist coastal pocket in Sant Pol de Mar that appears on Gays-Cruising as a cruising beach. Spain's Federation of Naturism identifies Playa de la Murtra as also known as El Molí or El Refugi, a strong name-level alias. The original cruising directory also lists a separate 'Playa de la Murtra' very close by, so these may duplicate one short coastline. Naturist designation and unnamed monthly directory check-ins do not independently confirm current cruising encounters.
